name: Silver Street
desc1: This is a cobblestoned street. It is dimly lit by guttering lanterns
desc2: hung from tall posts. The street is fairly quiet here, with a few
desc3: people scurrying towards their respective destinations. The massive
desc4: Arena wall can be seen to the north, and the back of a tall noble's
desc5: house is to the south. Silver street continues to the east and west.
